attributes.morphology: lamellar eutectic morphology at interdendritic areas

evidence.quote: With more C in the alloy(x = 0.5), the alloy exhibits typical hypoeutectic microstructure where lamellar eutectic morphology consisting of the alternative matrix phase and carbide phase could be observed at some interdendritic area.
